scope: hundred-grasp campaign only; earlier local-dual campaign, fixed C/F/G groups, empty-jaw calibration and recoveries excluded

evidence.verification: workstation download and per-payload length/SHA verification completed before this retrospective
evidence.derivation: select all action=pick results; closure requires a recorded close-phase gripper step in full events; use the recorded empty controller event list for the single startup exception with no event file; direct outcome from final error

event_file_coverage.handling: the one startup exception has an empty recorded controller event list and no closure; retained as software_exception

outcome_kind: local program outcomes, not independently adjudicated physical success

source_variation.not_equivalent_to: number of complete dependency sets or independently evaluated algorithms

timing.excluded: sum of pick result finished-started only; excludes compilation, archive finalization, diagnosis, recovery, tests, deployment and powered-off gaps

crosscutting_observations.root_cause_taxonomy: not established; direct outcomes may share upstream causes

limitations: Mixed code, appearance and scene conditions: ratios do not estimate one fixed physical policy.
Some nonpasses are uncertainty or refusal, not proof that a physical pickup failed.
Images were not all independently relabelled in this retrospective.
Earlier fixed 10/10 group is valid only in its recorded supervised setting and is not included here.
No robot motion, new capture, model training or guard changes performed for this report.
